name: Hoppscotch
description: The Hoppscotch API client on the Cate canvas: connects to a Hoppscotch instance you run (docker AIO auto-detected on localhost), embeds its UI reverse-proxied and loopback-bound, and ships a built-in Proxyscotch-compatible request proxy so API calls execute server-side (no webview CORS limits).
